messages:
Sam (AE): quick sync — Acme wants an on-prem POC next month. asks: 90-day platform fee waiver, Silver support during POC, and KMS integration. they also want proof we can do private infra with low ops risk. can we do a straight waiver?
Jesse (SE): what commit are they willing to make post-poc? waiver request is common but need a hook. any baseline numbers?
Sam (AE): they verbally said ~100k ARR potential but no signed commit yet. looking to move fast; prefatory POC to close enterprise deal. security questionnaire pending.
Priya (Sales Ops): FYI deal desk policy: platform fee waivers or >25% list discount require deal desk approval. standard approach is credits tied to an annual commit.
Liam (Finance): rough math: list platform fee for private on-prem = $12,000/mo (our standard), so 3 months full waiver = $36k revenue give-up. with Silver support add-on ~3k/mo so another $9k for POC window. if they convert to a 12mo commit >= $120k we can absorb as marketing/closing credit.
Jesse (SE): propose formal POC credit structure to present — keeps commercial leverage and addresses their ask. sample proposal below to get comments:

```
POC proposal (draft):
- Platform fee: $12k/mo list (Private)
- Support: Silver = $3k/mo (optional during POC)
- POC concession: 100% platform fee credit for 90 days IF customer signs 12-month Private commitment >= $120k within 30 days of POC end.
- Fallback: 50% platform fee credit for 60 days if no 12mo commit but signs 6mo pilot >= $60k.
- KMS integration: one-time $5k (can be waived with 12mo commit).
- Professional services / onboarding: quoted separately.
```

Anya (Legal): +1 to tying credits to a signed commitment. legal needs an addendum for POC credits, KMS access, and data handling for on-prem. we should add a clause that credits are forfeited if customer terminates for convenience during first 90 days after conversion.
Priya (Sales Ops): good. I'll open a deal desk ticket — need: final commercial ask, target commit threshold, and which support tier to include in the POC. @Liam please flag finance approval level (we need sign-off for >$30k impact).
Liam (Finance): I can pre-approve the conditional structure:
- Approve 100% 90-day platform credit ONLY if 12mo commit >= $120k and signed within 30 days of POC completion.
- Approve fallback 50%/60d credit for 6mo pilot >= $60k.
- Approve waiver of KMS fee only when 12mo commit met.
If sales wants unconditional full waiver we need exec-level approval; not approving that here.
Sam (AE): sounds fair. i'll present that to Acme — framing as a conversion incentive rather than a freebie.
Jesse (SE): minor ops note: to enable KMS in their air-gapped environment we'll need a short SOW for onsite work (2-3 days). include PS estimate in the commercial package.
Priya (Sales Ops): deal desk ticket created: DD-2026-482. attaching finance calc and draft proposal. next step: Sam to confirm if customer can commit to the 12mo threshold.
Sam (AE): i'll ask for the commit during the kickoff call tomorrow. also pushing security questionnaire answers — @Anya can you provision the addendum template?
Anya (Legal): on it. I'll draft the POC addendum with the credit-for-commit language and upload to the deal desk ticket by EOD.
poc-tracker-bot: POC milestone created — Acme POC kickoff scheduled for 2026-04-02.
Sam (AE): thanks team :thumbsup: — will update after the call.
Priya (Sales Ops): one ask — if customer wants Silver included during POC as part of credit, we should document it explicitly (so we don't accidentally bill).
Sam (AE): noted. will confirm.
Liam (Finance): if they push for faster credits or earlier recognition, escalate to me before promising.
Sam (AE): got it. closing thread for now, will post next update after kickoff. cheers.
